dataset.label: Corrected precipitation
dataset.limitations: Precipitation is a gridded estimate at one representative point, not a township-wide average. NASA POWER (MERRA-2) data for Myanmar change abruptly during 2008 (implausibly low rainfall and shifted soil wetness, temperature and humidity before then); compare only values from 2009 onward.
